design: Reproduce all prior half/half endpoints using the original support. For each band/channel/frame, average trace-normalized 3x3-patch covariance from nine remaining disjoint exposure pairs. Use nonoverlapping patches on a fixed grid free of rails. Evaluate on the omitted pair, multiplying shape by the same input variance used by the independent-input model. Compare error relative to empirical output-sum variance, holding parameters constant over all folds. Pairs are disjoint in exposures; tiles and readings are dependent.
